prerequisite: Run replace_alignment_geometry first to swap the centreline; use this node when the old sample lines still sit on the old geometry. Division of labour with create_sample_lines: that one creates the group, this one refreshes after a geometry swap (keeping the group and its sampled sources)
fixture_requirements: An alignment with a sample line group that has configured sampled sources (IsSampled)
A noticeable length change after the geometry swap (verifies the station sequence follows the new length)
Old sample lines in the group visibly misaligned with the new geometry (refresh effect visible to the eye)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
Group object and name unchanged: GetSampleLineGroupIds is the same set before and after (no group deleted or created)
The group's IsSampled source settings are preserved (the essential difference from create_sample_lines)
All old lines removed: old_lines == line count in the group before refresh; new lines are perpendicular to the new geometry
Station sequence = start + k*interval; a final remainder under 0.5 merges into the end line (same rule as create_sample_lines)
When interval/swath are omitted they are inferred from the existing lines (line count -> spacing, half the first line's bounding-box diagonal -> swath); if inference fails, 50/50
interval <= 0 or swath <= 0 throws; a spacing longer than the alignment (zero lines) throws
An alignment without a sample line group throws and names the alignment (no silent group creation)
An unknown alignment name throws and names it
Results match the products\waterbox command C3DF-RefreshSampleLines(CYX) on the same drawing and parameters (same SampleLineRefreshCore)
